data.narrative:
Breen Energy is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Chris Ochoa, Renat Yusufov, and Susannah Vickers. The company has raised $3M to date. The relevant comp universe comprises one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables to support a median valuation method.

Given data constraints, stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method. Using the $3M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $8M. This method assumes Breen Energy will advance to Series A with normalized dilution and growth metrics consistent with frontier-tech seed cohorts.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M (low) to $9M (high), with a median point of $8M. This range reflects uncertainty around comparable company selection in the Climate & Energy sector at the seed stage. Key risks to valuation include technology validation risk, capital intensity of frontier-energy solutions, and limited visibility into Breen's specific technical and commercial milestones. A peer-median approach becomes viable only with identification of at least three additional same-stage or similar-tier climate-tech seed companies.
